owner acceptance of continuous native playback

isolated_current_checkout_debug_native_v.interpretation: This idle-desktop rerun reproduces the macOS minimization failure; concurrent desktop use is not a sufficient explanation. Resize, fullscreen entry/exit, stable size restoration, capture and shutdown pass. The reason the Winit/AppKit minimize request does not produce an OS-reported minimized state remains undetermined.

manual_minimize_probe.interpretation: A second direct Session probe returned requested=true but Winit continued reporting minimized=false. This supports the native verifier result but does not identify whether AppKit rejected the request or the window remained ineligible.

settled_resize_minimization_recheck.result: The minimization failure persists after waiting for a stable resize and confirming the window is focused. Resize, fullscreen entry/exit, stable size restoration, deterministic capture and shutdown passed. The failure is not explained by issuing the minimize request during an unsettled resize; its cause remains undetermined.

isolated_no_resize_minimization_probe.result: With no resize or fullscreen transition, the focused window reported its minimize button enabled. After set_window minimized=true, OS-reported minimized and occluded both remained false for eight seconds. This rules out resize/fullscreen as prerequisites for reproducing the failure; it does not establish whether AppKit rejected miniaturize or a separate application/window eligibility condition applies.

appkit_reference_minimize_check.result: An independent plain AppKit window also failed to miniaturize through either method while active, key, visible, and enabled. This evidence supports a host/runtime-level disposition rather than an engine-specific window configuration cause, but it does not identify whether the cause is macOS 27.0.1 or local session policy.
appkit_reference_minimize_check.interpretation_limit: Does not test a user clicking the window traffic-light button or another macOS version.

traffic_light_ui_attempt.action: Attempted a CUA accessibility click on the active Pixel Engine Lab element identified as the minimize button.
traffic_light_ui_attempt.tool_error: The post-click CUA accessibility/screenshot request failed with ScreenCaptureKit SCStreamErrorDomain code -3811 (failed to start stream).
traffic_light_ui_attempt.limitation: A separate long-running packaged Pixel Engine process with the same app identity/title was present, so the app binding could not prove that the click targeted the current release process. Do not count this as a verified traffic-light minimize test.

current_release_native_verification_2026.native_lifecycle_result: Resize, stable size restoration, fullscreen entry/exit, fixed-tick capture, command handling and shutdown passed. The only failing lifecycle assertion was minimization.

current_checkout_gpu_verification_2026_1.scope_note: GPU checks passed on the current checkout. Native lifecycle results are recorded separately above; this run does not validate Windows/DX12, another adapter, or sustained target-hardware playback.

winit_backend_inspection_2026_10_19.observed_implementation: set_minimized(true) calls NSWindow.miniaturize; set_minimized(false) calls NSWindow.deminiaturize; is_minimized reads NSWindow.isMiniaturized.
winit_backend_inspection_2026_10_19.engine_call_path: crates/engine-lab/src/window.rs Native::process_line handles set_window.minimized by calling self.window.set_minimized(minimized).
winit_backend_inspection_2026_10_19.interpretation: The engine call matches the pinned Winit macOS implementation. An independent active AppKit reference window also failed to miniaturize on macOS 27.0.1 with the miniaturize button enabled. This supports a host/session limitation, but does not identify its cause or verify another macOS version; leave the gate open.

current_source_audit.interpretation: The full resize/fullscreen/minimization lifecycle result predates the benchmark-only occlusion guard and remains open at minimization. The current release source was built and the native benchmark occlusion-abort path was verified separately; this is not a full native lifecycle rerun. Windows/DX12, other adapters and sustained native playback remain separate gates.

This does not prove that the OS minimized the window and does not isolate AppKit behavior from desktop focus/occlusion. Keep minimization open.
